notes:
Dahu 0.102.3 beta for Windows

- Fixed a false not-responding warning after closing a document and choosing Cancel.
- Waiting in Save / Don't save / Cancel, a file picker or a blocking update no longer triggers the native close-request timeout once the interface has responded.
- Repeated close requests are handled independently without overlapping quit dialogs. The emergency Quit / Wait prompt remains available if the interface genuinely stops responding.

Installer and automatic-update package for Windows. Updater signature included; the executable is not Authenticode-signed.
